They can also be purchased from the traveling [[Merchant]]s [[Agus]] and [[Yammo]]. When drunk, Fresh Milk will restore half of a [[Heart]] to [[Link]]'s [[Life Gauge]]. At the [[Kochi Dye Shop]], Fresh Milk can be used as an ingredient to make [[White Dye]]. At a [[Cooking Pot]], Fresh Milk is required to cook the following [[Meal]]s: {{Data Table Copy |collapse= true |fromPage= Food in Breath of the Wild |storedAs= Meals |columns= Item, Ingredients |rowsWith= Fresh Milk }} ==={{TotK|-}}=== {{Stub|TotK}} Fresh Milk reappears in {{TotK}}. [[Dantz]], a worker at [[Hateno Pasture]], claims that the secret to the Fresh Milk that their [[Hateno Cow]]s produce is a special feed he makes for them. However, he recently has not been able to procure the [[Acorn]]s he needs to make this feed. This has resulted in the Pasture having no Fresh Milk to sell. As a reward for bringing Dantz three [[Acorn]]s during the [[Side Quest]] "[[Dantz's Prize Cows]]", he will give [[Link]] one bottle of Fresh Milk. Following this, Link can receive Fresh Milk from Dantz at any time in exchange for three Acorns. Fresh Milk is required to [[Cooking|Cook]] the following [[Meal]]s: {{Data Table Copy |collapse= true |fromPage= Food in Tears of the Kingdom |storedAs= Meals |columns= Item, Ingredients |rowsWith= Fresh Milk }} ==={{EoW|-}}=== {{Descriptions EoW}} Fresh Milk is an [[Ingredient]] that can be combined with another Ingredient to make a [[Smoothie]]. When used in one, it usually allows the Smoothie to restore significantly more [[Heart]]s. It can also be drunk on its own to restore half a Heart. Fresh Milk can be purchased in bulk at [[Hyrule Ranch]].
